title: 2D Self-Conditioned [A(v),B(v),C(v),D(v)]
text: Implement gain-scheduled state-space controller in self-conditioned form depending on two scheduling parameters, 4 inputs, 1 output; {A-matrix(v1,v2)} sets a -matrix of the state-space implementation, {B-matrix(v1,v2)} sets the b -matrix of the state-space implementation, {C-matrix(v1,v2)} sets the c -matrix of the state-space implementation, {D-matrix(v1,v2)} sets the d -matrix of the state-space implementation, {First scheduling variable (v1) breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for first scheduling variable, {Second scheduling variable (v2) breakpoints} sets the breakpoints for second scheduling variable, {Initial state, x_initial} sets the initial states and {Poles of A(v)-H(v)*C(v)} sets the desired poles. Values come from the instance.

params.name: A-matrix(v1,v2)
params.values: A -matrix of the state-space implementation A (default) | array

params.name: B-matrix(v1,v2)
params.values: B -matrix of the state-space implementation B (default) | array

params.name: C-matrix(v1,v2)
params.values: C -matrix of the state-space implementation C (default) | array

params.name: D-matrix(v1,v2)
params.values: D -matrix of the state-space implementation D (default) | array

params.name: First scheduling variable (v1) breakpoints
params.values: Breakpoints for first scheduling variable v1_vec (default) | vector

params.name: Second scheduling variable (v2) breakpoints
params.values: Breakpoints for second scheduling variable v2_vec (default) | vector
